hypothesis: The leaf-labeled EML grammar S → 1 | x | eml(S,S) has no 1-D integer invariant like degree. Exhaustive enumeration through 5 internal nodes matches 2^{k+1} C_k and exhibits same-size trees that disagree as functions. US-4′ is withheld.

controls.description: Tree counts by internal-node number must equal 2^{k+1} C_k. This is independent of evaluation.
Evaluation uses real exp/log. Nonpositive right-hand arguments and overflow are undefined.
The 6-point positive grid is a registered representation. Agreement on it is not function identity.
The run must not claim that fiber mass predicts gradient recovery.

gates.criterion: eml(x,1) and eml(1,x) disagree at x=2 with the closed forms exp(x) and e-ln(x).
All-ones size-2 trees recover e-1 vs exp(e) and are constant in x.
